entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, that Nakanohara guy[n]was a piece of cake!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If we can take down some kinda[n]big target next, we're totally[n]gonna get famous.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey! We're trying to help[n]people, not get famous!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But if people don't know who[n]we are, how're we gonna give[n]them any courage?
He's right.
Are you sure, Ryuji?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: See?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Am I wrong?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't think that you're[n]necessarily wrong...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But should we really be doing[n]this at all if we don't have[n]a reason like with Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You mean we shouldn't be[n]sticking our noses into[n]other people's business?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno, man. If someone's in[n]trouble, it's only natural[n]to wanna help 'em out!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, I agree with that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And I guess I was glad we were[n]able to solve the stalker case.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Plus, what good are our Personas[n]if we don't use 'em for good?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't you agree, [fName]?
Definitely.
I want to help people.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah... You're right.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The same goes for me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We don't got much time to be[n]arguing over this either. That[n]Madarame(?) guy bothers me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah. But no getting carried[n]away, you understand?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And don't do anything to stand[n]out like fail all your exams.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh crap! Speaking of that, I[n]haven't studied at all...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What about that star? The[n]one Jose gave us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wonder if that could help[n]us ace the exams...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, somehow I doubt that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell, I'd settle for just[n]not failing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Bargaining isn't gonna help you[n]here. We wouldn't use it for[n]that in the first place.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Maybe you should just, I dunno,[n]put some actual effort in?[n]You've still got time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Fiiine...
